method.region_definition: WCVP TDWG3 species-native and explicitly introduced wild original status
method.availability_background: 0.5 degree world mesh clipped to WCVP polygons, environmental background climate from cached original ~1km CHELSA pixel without resampling
method.sampling: one original source observation per taxon×status×5° equal-sin(latitude) cell×original observer, no phenotype eligibility conditioning
method.analysis: Two common-background climate principal components (balanced native/introduced available environments), 80x80 common grid, Gaussian-smoothed density divided by within-region available background density, Schoener D and 95% probability-content exclusive mass
method.not_exact_ecospat: Román et al. (2021) ecospat 100x100 PCA-env with 10 km data, Rad_sd and Human Footprint; current V4 uses 80x80 and original ~1km RSDS mean, no Human Footprint, no equivalency or similarity permutations

limitations: Occurrence-based range medians are descriptive conditional on original cached CHELSA source pixels and original user×site cell sample, not full estimated realized climatic niche.
Both overall WCVP available backgrounds fail the prespecified 80%-coverage threshold. Schoener D values are restricted-cache exploratory figures, NOT verified global niche equivalency or expansion.
Native available area ≈66–67%; introduced available area ≈36–46%; absent rasters in South America, Africa and Australasia prohibit cross-continent PCA-env tests.

Only North American C. vulgare introduced available climate background reaches >=80% areal coverage; native background still only 66%, so its D cannot be compared directly with Román 2021 reported North America D=0.5486.
Environmental predictors and resolution differ from Román 2021 (BIO1/BIO4/BIO12/BIO15 plus RSDS mean here, vs Rad_sd and Human Footprint at ~10km there).
Maximum entropy species occurrence relative to selected survey-effort background requires its own bias correction and spatial predictive evaluation; PCA-env D is not MaxEnt AUC.
Photographic head response has been deliberately excluded from this niche comparison; no morphological adaptation or evolution claim.
next_action: Extend only missing original raster coverage in WCVP native and introduced polygons, starting C. vulgare Africa/South America BIO1/BIO4/BIO12/BIO15/RSDS, validate source exact pixel SHA and rerun availability-corrected PCA-env 100x100 with geography/observer/source-effort sensitivity before linking flower orientation.
